sources.snippet: Overview Real-ESRGAN-x4plus is a super-resolution model that upscales images by 4x while removing noise and artifacts with minimal quality loss. Built and maintained by qualcomm, this model is a larger and more powerful variant of Real-ESRGAN-general-x4v3, derived from the original Real-ESRGAN architecture.
